meaning:
ἀνα-καθ-ίζω
(see: καθίζω);
1. trans., to set up.
2. Intrans., to sit up: Luk.7:15 (WH, mg., ἐκάθισεν), Act.9:40 (frequently in medical writings: MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)

elsewhere.note: He who was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he gave him to his mother.
Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
